suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
use JOIN instead of implicit Cartesian product
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT p.d_year AS d_year,
       p.brand_id AS brand_id,
       p.brand AS brand,
       SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           d.d_year AS d_year,
           i.i_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
           i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
           i.i_brand AS brand
    FROM date_dim d
    CROSS JOIN item i
    WHERE d.d_moy = 11
      AND i.i_manufact_id = 816
) p
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = p.d_date_sk
                    AND ss.ss_item_sk = p.i_item_sk
GROUP BY p.d_year, p.brand_id, p.brand
ORDER BY p.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
